hypotheses.justification: The statement and `IsParabolic` definition do not require this assumption; it is used by `isParabolic_mk_iff` only to classify quotient representatives. Instead, use the existential definition directly: a parabolic SL representative of `g` has an inverse representative of `g⁻¹`, and conversely. In the 2×2 calculations, inversion preserves the discriminant and preserves the condition of being non-scalar: the adjugate has the same diagonal-equality and off-diagonal-zero conditions. These facts hold over any commutative ring, including the zero ring and rings with zero divisors, so the equivalence remains true without `[NoZeroDivisors R]`.
